review.name: Titan Golem
findings: Fresh baseline twelve source face/body animation slices and all 216 actual technique frames actually inspected. Lower stone chin pulls subtly during secondary idle, recoil and defeat. Body joints and stone shoulder plates remain connected; jaw binding repair candidate pending.

Separate final second pass actually inspected all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, 32 low/medium production transition slices, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 native technique frames in twelve lossless strips and all sixteen atlas cells. All passed. Source and battle each pass 203 geometry poses, 619 independently frozen face poses and 468 blends. Complete lower-jaw incremental binding preserves sculpt, UVs, textures, rig, all authored curves and 16488 protected vertex palettes. Seven focused regression/animation-bank tests and production build passed. Whole roster and live release pending.
